messages.subject: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm looking to rent a diamond floor saw, do you have one available at Kempele? I've rented from you a few times before, account under Teemu Alatalo.

Thanks
Teemu

messages.subject: Re: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Thanks for your message. We do have a diamond floor saw at the Kempele depot. Could you let me know which dates you're thinking of so I can check the booking calendar?

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
One more thing while I have you - I need to bring back the 140L concrete mixer I've had out. When can I drop it off at Kempele?

Teemu

messages.subject: Late return charges on recent rental
messages.body:
Hello,

Looking at the invoice for our recent rental, there's a late return charge that shouldn't be there. Late returns are free of charge for the first three days every time, and we returned within that period. Please review and correct.

Regards,
Rakennusliike Törmänen Oy

messages.subject: Upcoming rental
messages.body:
Good evening,

We have a booking coming up and I wanted to ask whether any kind of loyalty gesture would be possible, given that we've been renting from Haapaharju regularly for several years now. We've always been happy with the service.

Best regards,
Rakennus Piispanen Oy

messages.subject: Re: Upcoming rental
messages.body:
Hi,

Appreciate the loyalty, and you're right that you've been great long-term customers. Happy to waive the damage deposit on your next rental. Just mention this email when you place the booking and we'll sort it out.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Upcoming rental
messages.body:
Hi,

We'd like to go ahead and book now, and wanted to confirm the deposit waiver that Marko Seppälä offered earlier in this thread. He said the damage deposit would be waived on our next rental as a loyalty gesture. Please apply that to this booking.

Thank you,
Rakennus Piispanen Oy

messages.subject: Scaffold tower - date change needed
messages.body:
We need to change the dates on our existing booking for the 6m scaffold tower. The project schedule shifted so we'll need it later than originally planned. Can you check whether the new dates are available?

Meri-Lapin Maansiirto Oy

messages.subject: Re: Scaffold tower - date change needed
messages.body:
Hi,

Noted. I'll check the availability for the 6m scaffold tower against the revised dates and come back to you.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Scaffold tower - date change needed
messages.body:
Separate thing - we also need to return the mini dumper (1-tonne) we currently have. What's the best time to bring it to the Rovaniemi depot?

Thanks,
Meri-Lapin Maansiirto Oy

messages.subject: Unfair late fee
messages.body:
We were charged a late fee on our recent rental but this was not a genuine late return. We arrived at the depot at the agreed time and nobody was there to receive the equipment. When we came back the following morning the system had already registered it as late. This was a mix-up on the depot side and we should not be paying for it.

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Re: Unfair late fee
messages.body:
Hi,

I've looked into this and confirmed there was a staffing issue at the depot that day. The late fee was applied incorrectly and I'll process a full refund for it. You should see it credited back to your account within a few business days.

Sorry about the trouble.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Unfair late fee
messages.body:
Hello,

Just following up on this. Petri Isokangas confirmed the late fee from the depot mix-up would be refunded but we haven't seen it come through yet. Could you check the status?

Regards,
Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Concrete breaker - date change
messages.body:
Hi,

Quick question - I need to move my booking for the hydraulic concrete breaker to different dates. Is that doable? Let me know what you need from me.

Jari Peltoniemi
